python3 -c "
import pathlib, re
p = pathlib.Path('tests/codegen/exceptions.rs')
t = p.read_text()
t = t.replace('''/// MEASURED on \`php -n\` 8.5.6: the block, \`#0 {main}\`, and a \`  thrown in FILE on line N\` tail''', '''/// The harness splits php diagnostics out of stdout by KIND PREFIX; the trace lines carry none,
/// so they stay in \`stdout\` while the \`Fatal error:\` line moves to \`located_diagnostics\`.
///
/// MEASURED on \`php -n\` 8.5.6: the block, \`#0 {main}\`, and a \`  thrown in FILE on line N\` tail''', 1)
t = t.replace('''        output.located_diagnostics.contains(\"Stack trace:\")
            && output.located_diagnostics.contains(\"#0 {main}\"),
        \"expected php's trace block, got: {}\",
        output.located_diagnostics''', '''        output.stdout.contains(\"Stack trace:\") && output.stdout.contains(\"#0 {main}\"),
        \"expected php's trace block, got: {}\",
        output.stdout''', 1)
t = t.replace('''    assert!(later.located_diagnostics.contains(\"#0 {main}\"));''', '''    assert!(later.stdout.contains(\"#0 {main}\"));''', 1)
t = t.replace('''        output.located_diagnostics.contains(\"fopen('', 'r')\"),
        \"expected the builtin frame with its arguments, got: {}\",
        output.located_diagnostics''', '''        output.stdout.contains(\"fopen('', 'r')\"),
        \"expected the builtin frame with its arguments, got: {}\",
        output.stdout''', 1)
t = t.replace('''        output.located_diagnostics.contains(\"#1 {main}\"),
        \"the builtin frame is #0, so {{main}} is #1: {}\",
        output.located_diagnostics''', '''        output.stdout.contains(\"#1 {main}\"),
        \"the builtin frame is #0, so {{main}} is #1: {}\",
        output.stdout''', 1)
t = t.replace('''        !output.located_diagnostics.contains(\"Stack trace:\"),
        \"a module with a user function must print no trace rather than a short one: {}\",
        output.located_diagnostics''', '''        !output.stdout.contains(\"Stack trace:\"),
        \"a module with a user function must print no trace rather than a short one: {}\",
        output.stdout''', 1)
p.write_text(t)
print('assertions read stdout')
"; RUST_MIN_STACK=33554432 cargo test --test codegen_tests exceptions::test_uncaught_report 2>&1 | grep -E "^test |test result|got:" | head -8: assertions read stdout test codegen::exceptions::test_uncaught_report_names_the_raising_builtin_and_its_arguments ... ok test codegen::exceptions::test_uncaught_report_omits_a_trace_it_cannot_complete ... ok test codegen::exceptions::test_uncaught_report_carries_phps_stack_trace_block ... ok test result: ok. 3 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 8847 filtered out; finished in 1.66s
